author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
This is a display-only quirk — PE's v17 (TAXSIM "Itemized Deductions in taxable income") reports the itemized calculation regardless of whether the filer ultimately took the standard deduction. It doesn't affect federal tax (v19/fiitax) since the standard-vs-itemized choice happens at the federal taxable-income level.

TAXSIM-35 has the same quirk per its docs — column 17 shows the hypothetical itemized amount even when the standard deduction was chosen. PE-taxsim mirrors that to maintain TAXSIM-compatibility on the column semantics.

Closing as known-behavior consistent with TAXSIM-35's own treatment.
